verdict.rationale: Openness of a GPU's source (hardware design, firmware, or driver code under an open license) is a fair question for a data-center GPU. Nothing in the evidence pack shows H200 source released under an open license. The only open-source mention (docs-46) is about a separate 5G/6G research library, not the H200 itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
